newsitem.title: USA: Baldwin & Lyons Inc Q3 net drops.
newsitem.headline: Baldwin & Lyons Inc Q3 net drops.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 income from continuing operations excludes $1,154,000 or $0.08/shr in realized net gains on investments.

Q3 1995 operating income excludes $3,350,000 or $0.23/share in net realized investment gains, $600,000 or $0.04 in discontinued operations income and $7,464,000 or $0.50 gain on sale of Hoosier Insurance Co.
Including gains in both periods, Q3 1996 net income $5,590,000 or $0.39 a share vs $16,541,000 or $1.11 a year ago.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 results exclude $3,548,000 or $0.25/share in realized net gains on investments.
Nine-month 1995 results exclude $4,472,000 or $0.30/share net investment gains, $742,000 or $0.05 in discontinued operations income and $7,464,000 or $0.50 in gain on sale of Hoosier Insurance Co.
Including items, nine-month 1996 net income $16,374,000 or $1.14 a share vs $25,387,000 or $1.70 a share.
